audience: Architects evaluating a constrained enterprise architecture proposal
useful_action: Compose the reference business context and inspect rule-backed design decisions

editorial_opportunity.question: Compare two explicit business contexts and explain the resulting architecture delta, including unresolved decisions.
editorial_opportunity.proof_required: Use a current inspectable artifact or explicitly synthetic worked example. Attribute external claims to dated primary sources. Preserve the strongest limitation.
editorial_opportunity.success_observation: Observe completion of the useful action separately from search impressions, indexing and independent AI citations.

constraints: No fabricated first-hand results, reviews, users, credentials or endorsements.
Profile validity does not prove indexing, recommendations or rank.
Preserve product privacy and publication boundaries.
